title: Dimension of the support submodule
statement: Fix a prime $p$ and an integer $n$, and let $V = \bbf_p^{\,n} \times \bbf_p^{\,n}$ be the space of pairs of coordinate vectors over the prime field $\bbf_p$. For a subset $C \subseteq \{1, \dots, n\}$, let $V_C \subseteq V$ be the support submodule consisting of those pairs $(u, w)$ for which $u_i = 0$ and $w_i = 0$ at every index $i \notin C$. Then $V_C$ has dimension $\dim_{\bbf_p}(V_C) = 2\lvert C\rvert$ over $\bbf_p$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a subset of the index set Fin n
V_C is the pairs vanishing outside C
